external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer. They sign in with an email address and a password and get a session cookie.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can view the invoice payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details, and it asks the payer to sign in to nothing.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console and can open billing-app sessions as customer users.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in to the admin console with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, which loads and saves invoices and requests PDF rendering.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself, and the database has no row-level security. The app connects with one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue containing PDF render jobs with a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: To make a PDF, the billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket containing rendered PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: All companies share one PDF bucket in the cloud platform. The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: Customer users interact with the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie; second factor: none
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer data and payout bank details

data_flows.name: read invoices
data_flows.description: The billing app loads invoices and related tenant data from the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When a user opens an invoice, the billing app loads it by its invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers and payout bank details

data_flows.name: save invoice fields
data_flows.description: The billing app saves fields submitted by the invoice edit form into the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app saves every field it receives, including the paid flag and the company's payout bank account
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoice fields, including the paid flag and payout bank account

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number to the payer.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: An invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: The payer follows the invoice link to the billing app's payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name and bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: deliver render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice selected using the job's company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes the rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Support-agent account credentials and one-time code

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user on behalf of a support agent.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Everything the agent then does is recorded in the tenant database against that customer user, and not against the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session and actions

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform in which the shared billing app, tenant database and PDF bucket are described as running.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-company tenant boundary; each customer company is one tenant.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office
trust_boundaries.description: The support office network from which support agents use the admin console.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
